classes.name: Loop diuretics
classes.description: Loop diuretics: furosemide (Lasix; tablets, oral solution; Furoscix subcutaneous on-body infusor and Lasix ONYU subcutaneous, alternatives only, never the pick), torsemide (generic; Soaanz), bumetanide (Bumex), ethacrynic acid (Edecrin; for sulfa allergy). Not thiazides.
classes.plainDescription: A strong water pill that removes extra fluid, for heart failure, kidney and liver disease and swelling.

preferredAgent.sig: Edema: 20 to 80 mg by mouth as a single dose; repeat or raise by 20 or 40 mg no sooner than 6 to 8 hours later until the response is right (label). Check potassium.
preferredAgent.plainSig: One pill in the morning. Your dose may be adjusted to how much fluid you lose.

records.verificationNote: Read Highmark c20 (loop diuretics) from the raw HTML. Furosemide 20 mg tablet is Tier 1 (LCG icon); furosemide 40 and 80 mg tablets and oral solutions are Tier 1. Torsemide and bumetanide tablets are Tier 1 with no icons. Lasix ONYU subcutaneous kit is Tier 2 with QL only. Furoscix (both forms) is Tier 3 with PA, QL and day-supply icons. Soaanz is Tier 3 with PA. Lasix tablets, Edecrin and generic ethacrynic acid are Tier 3 with no icons. Enbumyst nasal spray is on the page but not in the class description; excluded. [Audit 2026-11-22: Highmark FormularyNavigator c20: Furosemide oral solution 10 mg/mL and 40 mg/5 mL (8 mg/mL) = Tier 1/ Formulary Generic Drug; Furosemide oral solution 40 mg/4 mL = Tier 3 /Non-Formulary Drug.]
